summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Vincco landing page redesign with real content. All major features working correctly including cascade layouts, language toggle, and contact form integration.

Contact form submission to /api/contacts working correctly
Contact CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete) all functional
Input validation working for invalid contact data
Hero section loads with original Vincco content ('Somos el vínculo perfecto')
All navigation links present and functional (Quiénes Somos, Servicios, Soluciones, Qué Nos Distingue, Qué Nos Respalda)
About section displays with cascade layout - Misión and Visión cards properly positioned
Services section shows 4 services with alternating left/right cascade layout
Solutions section tabs (Con Agente/Sin Agente) working correctly
Distinguishes section shows 6 items with waterfall/zigzag cascade layout
Backing section shows 4 cards with staggered heights
Language toggle (ES/EN) working on all sections
Contact form validates and submits successfully with success message
Mobile responsive design with hamburger menu functional
Smooth scroll navigation working for all sections
Backend integration verified - contact data properly saved and retrievable
